description: DTDL v2 schema for the CPU and Network MetricTypes (see docs/Metrics/01_CPU_NETWORK_FIELDS.md). Each Telemetry corresponds to one (MetricType, MetricName) pair. Network sensors support v1.1 Explicit list / Auto-detect mode via Parameters.Interface (bound) or Parameters.Interfaces (list / auto-detect); expanded sensors share the Telemetry DTMI and differentiate by ResourceId suffix. schemas[] publishes reusable Enums; every Telemetry's comment carries its validation rule.

schemas.description: Allowed MetricType discriminators in this Interface. Validation: Parameters.MetricType MUST equal one of these literals.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when Parameters.MetricType == 'cpu'.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when Parameters.MetricType == 'network'.
Allowed values of SensorGroup. CPU and Network sensors conventionally use 'SYS'.
Allowed values of SensorInfo.Schema. Validation: must match the Telemetry's native DTDL schema (see Telemetry.schema below).
Reusable Object schema for the Parameters block of every network Sensor in devicecfg.json. Field names use camelCase here; on-the-wire keys are PascalCase (the agent matches case-insensitively).
schemas.comment: DTDL v2 cannot express union types or cross-field mutual-exclusivity, so two rules are documented in prose only and enforced by dtdl-validate/scripts/config-rules.js: (1) 'interfaces' may also appear on the wire as a CSV string (still expanded into a string list); (2) 'interface' and 'interfaces' are mutually exclusive when both are non-empty.

fields.name: metricType
fields.description: Metric-family discriminator. For this Object MUST equal 'network'.

fields.name: metricName
fields.description: Specific network metric to collect (see NetworkMetricName enum).

fields.name: interface
fields.description: Single OS-level interface name. v1.0 mode: required. v1.1 mode: optional; when set disables expansion.

fields.name: interfaces
fields.description: Array of OS-level interface names. v1.1 only. Each entry becomes one expanded sensor sharing the parent Telemetry DTMI. Empty array (or empty CSV string on the wire) means auto-detect across every discovered interface.

contents.name: CpuUsage
contents.description: Overall CPU busy % across all cores (0.00-100.00). MetricType=cpu, MetricName=usage.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= 100 (rounded to 2 dp); reject NaN / +-Inf as sensor faults; sustained v > 95 for >= 5 min indicates saturation. Unit: percent.

contents.name: CpuLoad1
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0; unitless; v > 2 * nproc for >= 5 min indicates sustained overload. Returns 0.0 on non-Linux platforms.

contents.name: CpuLoad5
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0; unitless. Same overload threshold as CpuLoad1.

contents.name: CpuLoad15
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0; unitless. Same overload threshold as CpuLoad1.

contents.name: CpuContextSwitches
contents.description: Cumulative scheduler context-switch count since boot (/proc/stat ctxt). MetricType=cpu, MetricName=context_switches.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0 between samples; resets only on reboot (detect via system.boot_time). Always graph as rate, not absolute value.

contents.name: NetworkBytesSent
contents.description: Cumulative L2 bytes transmitted on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=bytes_sent. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0; resets only on reboot. Graph as rate(...) [bps].

contents.name: NetworkBytesReceived
contents.description: Cumulative L2 bytes received on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=bytes_received. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0; resets only on reboot. Graph as rate(...) [bps].

contents.name: NetworkPacketsSent
contents.description: Cumulative TX frame count on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=packets_sent. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0; resets only on reboot. Graph as rate(...) [pps].

contents.name: NetworkPacketsReceived
contents.description: Cumulative RX frame count on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=packets_received. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0; resets only on reboot. Graph as rate(...) [pps].

contents.name: NetworkErrors
contents.description: Cumulative total network errors (errors_in + errors_out) on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=errors. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0. Any sustained non-zero rate on Ethernet is abnormal -- investigate cable / NIC / driver.

contents.name: NetworkErrorsIn
contents.description: Cumulative receive errors (CRC / framing / FIFO drops) on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=errors_in. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0. Non-zero rate typically signals layer-1 problems (cabling, transceiver, FIFO overflow under load).

contents.name: NetworkErrorsOut
contents.description: Cumulative transmit errors (carrier loss / device failure) on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=errors_out. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0. Non-zero rate typically signals carrier loss or device-side TX failure.
